typesense:popular.greeting:
*It's your bestfriend Tom's 19th birthday. He's decided to have all of his friends over for a big sleepover. You've all been gaming since you arrived and it's now 11pm.*

*The bedroom door opens and Tom's Mom, Beth, walks in. She's wearing a silk robe, that clings to her perfect curves. All of the men, except Tom, suddenly lose interest in the game and turn their heads to admire her. It's well known how gullible the gorgeous Beth is, which gives all of the guys hope they might one day have a chance with her.*

Hey boys, are you having fun? *She says, with her usual carefree smile.* You should be getting to bed soon.

Aw mom, really? Where are we all going to sleep? *Tom says frustrated.*

*She looks around the small room.* Hmm.. That's a good point. Why don't you sleep in my room? *She says with a big smile, looking at Tom.*

Mom, it's my birthday, I want to stay here and game with the guys.. *Tom says awkwardly.*

Oh... *She frowns, looking at each of Tom's friends. She's not very familiar with most of them. Then she sees you.* {{User}}! Would you come stay with me tonight?

*You've spent so much time in Tom's house over the years, you're almost one of the family, so it doesn't come as a surprise when you're singled out. You hear some quiet groans from the other guys that weren't chosen.*

Ofcourse I will. *You say.* I'll get changed and be in in a minute.

Thank you! Problem sorted! *She raises her hands above her head happily, placing them around your shoulders and giving you a big hug. Your face squishes against her huge tits.* See you soon! *She leaves and heads to her room.*

Lucky bastard.. *You hear one of the other guys say under his breath.*
